purpose: Build a source-derived, independently checkable admission bridge that can map real agent-facing registration surfaces and real source revisions into the already-frozen RISU E2 semantic/C1 support contract without inventing semantic authority, widening the semantic kernel, or using heldout/gold information.
scientific_goal: After this bridge is fully qualified and frozen, select a brand-new metadata-only public-repository universe and perform a one-shot real-world selective-assurance heldout in which definitive RISU verdicts are possible only when exact source-derived authority survives independent reconstruction; all other units fail closed.

required: exact repository identity and immutable revision pair
exact source bytes and source SHA-256
opaque structural registration-surface locator produced by a frozen selector
language and structural registration kind/form derived mechanically from source
forbidden: human semantic annotation used as authority
repository popularity or project identity used to choose support behavior

must_include: exact source/projection/binding authority objects required by the frozen semantic/C1 contract
content-addressed provenance to exact source slices
required identifiers with independent derivation receipts
explicit support-profile identity that already exists in the frozen semantic boundary
ADMISSIBLE_EXISTING_SUPPORT.rule: The bridge may realize evidence that already exists in source; it may not create semantic facts that are not mechanically evidenced.

UNSUPPORTED.meaning: The real unit is outside existing support or exact authority cannot be realized. Future heldout execution must preserve the unit and emit INCOMPLETE with an explicit reason; no replacement or repair.

BRIDGE_INVALID.meaning: Malformed input, authority contradiction, internal nondeterminism, provenance escape, or checker disagreement. Development qualification fails.

development_method.corpus_policy: Use only synthetic adversarial fixtures plus public development repositories that are cryptographically excluded from both the old Gate2Eprime R1 39-repository universe and every later heldout. Development source may be inspected because it is not population evidence.
development_method.rust_policy: May remain explicitly unsupported unless a source-derived bridge is prospectively implemented and qualified before final bridge freeze.
development_method.no_post_hoc_language_target: Do not add language/profile support because a later heldout exposes a miss.

qualification_gates.requirement: Freeze this charter, exact development-corpus selection rule, negative-control rule and outcome taxonomy before development source inspection.

Prospectively generate adversarial cases for retrieved-but-discarded values, overwrite, bypass, wrong coordinate/resource binding, guard polarity, effect-before-guard, serialization survival, unresolved authority, duplicate/ambiguous registration and representation loss. Independent checker must agree and fail closed.
Run the bridge on a fixed public development corpus disjoint from all heldout candidates. Preserve first-complete failures; development repair is allowed only with new versioned qualification runs.

Apply semantics-preserving renaming/formatting/reordering transformations and information-removal transformations. Admission may not strengthen when evidence is removed, and source-provenance identities must remain exact.
Bridge producer and separately implemented rechecker derive logical authority from raw source independently. Definitive admission on disagreement is forbidden.

For bridge-admitted supported fixtures, compare frozen semantic predictions against independently generated executable/runtime observations wherever a preregistered fixture exists; no runtime observation may feed bridge authority.

Freeze exact bridge code blobs, rechecker blobs, source selectors, support predicates, configs, synthetic matrix, development-corpus identities, all first-complete qualification artifacts and a zero-heldout-exposure receipt.

required: development corpus frozen and permanently excluded from heldout
old Gate2Eprime R1 39 repositories remain source-unread by this track
bridge deterministic dual replay logically byte-identical
all semantic-kernel blobs match pre-bridge frozen identities
final_freeze_exit.after_exit: Only then freeze a NEW heldout metadata-universe selection recipe and execute it under a fresh one-shot challenge. The new heldout must be selected after RB6 so bridge development cannot be informed by heldout repository identities.

future_heldout_design.selection: metadata-only public repository universe -> development/old-candidate exclusion -> exact HEAD freeze -> fixed-seed cryptographic ranking -> frozen opaque structural selection -> deterministic real revision construction
future_heldout_design.gold: Must be independent, content-addressed and sealed before prediction execution or otherwise satisfy an explicitly prospectively reconciled truth-admissibility constitution before any target source read.
future_heldout_design.claim_boundary: Exact challenge counts only; no ecosystem prevalence claim from ten units.

success_ceiling: A successful future heldout can demonstrate that RISU not only fails closed outside support but can prospectively realize exact source-derived authority and make nontrivial, independently checkable definitive judgments on fresh real agent-tool revisions without post-hoc support widening.
next_authorized_action: Freeze a disjoint real-source development-corpus selection protocol and implement RB1 bridge/rechecker on synthetic-only fixtures before opening any public development source.
